base.rationale: E provides the strongest current typed lifecycle, exact repository fingerprint, independent assessment boundary, and broad public-safe evidence corpus on which to stage Atlas.

branches.strength: Recursive launch and evidence gates with participation-lineage coverage.
Editorial lenses and clean separation of archival, project, and portfolio layers.
Recursive evidence intake, atomic claims, and full-population audit trails.
Typed knowledge lifecycle, exact candidate fingerprinting, and independent assessment controls.
A general lifecycle framework joined to broad archival corpora.
Executable blind-spot evaluation and archive reconciliation.
Release readability, public contracts, and strict inference guards.
Adversarial projection correction and independently reviewed archive boundaries.
Documented recursive runs and reconciliation histories.
Append-safe intake, query tooling, inspectable proof bases, and visual evidence checks.
Recursive knowledge development and Chad-lens portfolio translation.
Explicit intake-to-maturation layers and production-readiness CI.
Deterministic grader separation, correction traceability, and governance-first projection decisions.
